profile.headline: Sr Staff Engineer
profile.summary:
Software development: 20 years
Team lead / Application architect: 14 years
Management: 12 years
Production support: 20 years

Leading development for McKesson's B2B pharmaceutical e-commerce application ($60B annual sales revenue).

Languages
•	Proficient in: Clojure, Java, Perl
•	Familiar with: C++, PHP, Typescript, Ceylon, Javascript

Software
•	Database: Oracle, MySQL, PosgreSQL, SQL Server
•	Messaging: Kafka, HornetQ, Jboss Messaging
•	Platforms: PCF, GKE, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Ubuntu
•	Middleware: JBoss Enterprise Application Platform 7.1, 6.3, 4.3, 5.1
•	EDI Software: Axway Cyclone Interchange 5, CSOS Director, B2Bi, Sterling Gentran Integration Suite 4, IBM Sterling Integrator 5
•	Frameworks: CDI 1.0, Spring 2.5 (XML), JEE 6, EJB 3, JPA, JMS, Hibernate, Google Web Toolkit, Selenium, Arquillian, JUnit, Struts, Seam 2
•	Performance/troubleshooting: Eclipse Memory Analyzer, sar, top, vmstat, dmesg, iostat

Process
•	Agile, Scrum, or LEAN/Kanban (11 years)
•	Continuous Delivery (5 years)

positions.description: Software engineer attempting to transform systems and culture at McKesson.
